decision.title: IR extensions for try/catch and constructors (packet 3.6b)

body.p: ; accepts the IR proposals of and (src/ir_internal.h, src/ir.c, src/ir_verify.c).

item.p: Adders: sxml_ir_unit_add_name_tests(unit, sxml_ir_name_test_view, &list), sxml_ir_unit_add_catch_clauses(unit, view, &list) and sxml_ir_unit_add_namespace_bindings(unit, view, &list) work as sxml_ir_unit_add_sort_keys, with accessors sxml_ir_unit_get_name_tests, _get_catch_clauses, _get_namespace_bindings. A LOCAL_NAME_WILDCARD test's local name is interned in the item heap's name pool (pool text never moves), so callers may free theirs; an empty one is INVALID_ARGUMENT. The static namespaces are one run of the same array.

sxml_ir_node_construction gains (a binding run; empty means the unit's static namespaces; lowering gives the static namespaces extended by enclosing direct constructors, for QT4 Constr-compelem-compname) and uint32_t construction_flags (SXML_IR_CONSTRUCTION_NO_PRESERVE_NAMESPACES, _NO_INHERIT_NAMESPACES, _PRESERVES_TYPES, _XSLT_RULES; 0 = construction strip, copy-namespaces preserve, inherit, XQuery rules). Lowering (3.9, 3.10) sets them per constructor from the prolog; XSLT (4.x) sets XSLT_RULES on literal result elements and xsl:element/xsl:document.

Evaluator (src/evaluator_construct.c): flags pick the copy request of content nodes (no-preserve, no-inherit, keep annotations), xs:anyType for elements under PRESERVES_TYPES, XSLT rules (REPLACE duplicates, XTDE codes) for ELEMENT and DOCUMENT; SHALLOW_COPY drops the element's namespaces under NO_PRESERVE (copy-namespaces "no") and keeps its type under PRESERVES_TYPES. Names given as strings resolve with . src/evaluator_try.c reads clauses through the accessors.

Verifier: TRY_CATCH needs a body and clauses or a finally body; each clause one or more name tests of a known kind, an error details slot of the function (bound in its handler only) and a handler. The constructor kinds and SHALLOW_COPY: fields the kind does not use must be empty (kinds as in the header), lists in range, known flags; a NONE name or value is allowed (the empty sequence: attribute {()} {} raises at run time, namespace {()} {...} is the default namespace). Only APPLY_TEMPLATES stays reserved.

Text form: constructors print name, value, then (namespaces p="u" ""="d"), (name-namespaces ...) and the flag words on one line, then the content; TRY_CATCH prints body, (catch (TESTS) $SLOT HANDLER) per clause and (finally BODY) (golden text in tests/ir_test.c). Dumps of the other kinds are unchanged.

Test units of tests/evaluator_try_test.c and tests/evaluator_construct_test.c use the adders; all of them pass the verifier (checked once in a scratch build, after giving shallow_others one content expression per copy: the IR is a tree).
